address: Piazza De Honestis Cavallino, Sassari, 07100, Italy
bio: This reliable restaurant has moved from the coast to simple, modern premises in the town of Sassari, where it has a new look and new chefs at the helm. The cuisine is as good as ever, with a focus on fish and seafood yet also including a few meat options, in dishes that are classic with a modern twist and cooked using predominantly Sardinian ingredients....
